papers.title: E089 Quantified-Chunk New-Post Cohort: Pre-registration with In-Flight Amendments (v1.2). Primary analysis re-scoped to P3; primary contribution a query-validity and namespace-drift taxonomy.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: E089 is a pre-registered field study testing how generative AI search engines cite cold, newly published content. The study used 12 posts arranged as six topic-matched A/B pairs. One page in each pair opened with a quantified-chunk template: a front-loaded definition, named entities and at least one hard number already deposited in a public source. The other used the standard template. I checked citation and chunk reconstruction at D14 and D28 across Google Search, AI Overviews, AI Mode and Perplexity Sonar. This version finishes the analysis re-scope that began in amendment v1.1 and changes what the study can reasonably claim. V1.1 had already narrowed the confirmatory analysis from all six pairs to the two coined-term pillar pairs, P3 and P4. The informational half of the cohort failed query validity because the target queries hadn't been screened for search demand or namespace ownership, and every pair was compromised in a different way. P4 later collapsed too. Both arms were namespace-invalid, although for different reasons. That left P3 as the only primary pair. P3 produced a measurable negative result on the registered dependent variable: reconstruction of the engineered opening chunk. None of the four answer surfaces reproduced the treatment page's front-loaded statistic. They did, however, reproduce the plain declarative definition almost word for word on both arms. So the number being placed at the front wasn't what got the content selected. That result comes from one pair at one timepoint, with no D14 baseline and a sample below the minimum-N standard. I'm therefore reporting it as a directional negative, not as a confirmatory finding about the template. The study's primary contribution is now a taxonomy of query-validity failure and namespace drift. Five of the six pairs were compromised through different mechanisms: foreign-entity namespace capture, product-brand ownership, dense-corpus collision, authority saturation, topic-invalid queries and within-pair namespace asymmetry. This extends my earlier work on namespace drift. Two incidental extraction positives remain in the record. Two cold control pages, published without amplification, earned citations in AI Overviews and Perplexity with their engineered openings reproduced. One was still being cited in an off-protocol observation roughly three weeks after its last confirmed read. Nothing about the experiment itself has changed. Treatment assignments, the randomisation seed, publishing schedule, hygiene baseline, measurement offsets and coding rules remain as registered in v1.1. This version changes only the analysis and interpretation plan. Deposited under CC BY 4.0.

papers.title: CLINICAL PROTOCOL FOR PRECISION FERTILITY MANAGEMENT
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Протокол реалізує систему наскрізного прецизійного менеджменту клітинного потенціалу, що заміщує застарілі лінійні шаблони реактивного лікування безпліддя. Управління репродуктивним віком розвивається як безперервний, динамічний біологічний процес від пубертату до менопаузи з метою мінімізації алостатичного навантаження, оксидативної деструкції та системного ефекту (запального). Хронологічна матриця (6 етапів управління) ● Препубертатна та підліткова (Juvenile & Pediatric Repro-Aging): Ранній скринінг нейроендокринних дисфункцій, профілактика синдрому RED-S у молодому спорті, захист гонадного пулу від впливу токсичних чинників. ● Преконцепційна та регенеративна (Active Preconception Resilience): епігенетичне відновлення якості гамет, елімінація фрагментації ДНК сперматозоїдів, усунення станів низької доступності енергії (LEA). ● Тазова гармонізація (Endo-Pelvic Silence Stage): Придушення локального та системного запального каскаду для досягнення «тазової тиші» перед імплантацією. Цільова група: пацієнтки з аденоміозом, хворобливим тазовим болем та тяжкими формами ендометріозу. ● Екстрена онкопротекція (Oncofertility Preservation Window): Негайне збереження гонадного потенціалу шляхом застосування надшвидких протоколів кріоконсервації гамет і тканини до початку гонадотоксичної терапії. ● Гестаційний та перинатальний супровід (Epigenetic Gestational Care): Нейтралізація перинатальних ризиків (передні пологи, гестаційні кровотечі), спричинених метаболічною пам'яттю клітин про дефіцит енергії. ● Репро-антиейджинг та менопаузальна реверсія (Repro-Antiaging & Menopausal Transition): прецизійна органопротекція, відновлення мітохондріального біогенезу та підтримка ендотеліальної функції в періоді згасання гормональної активності для збереження соматичного здоров’я. papers.title: Auditing Citation Behavior in AI-Generated Search Summaries: A Framework and a Case Study of Google AI Overviews
papers.abstract: Framework and empirical audit of citation behavior in AI-generated search summaries using provenance-aware measures.

papers.title: Measuring Google AI Overviews: Activation, Source Quality, Claim Fidelity, and Publisher Impact
papers.abstract: Large-scale longitudinal measurement of Google AI Overviews covering activation, source quality, atomic claim support, and publisher impact.

papers.title: Answer Bubbles: Information Exposure in AI-Mediated Search
papers.abstract: Cross-system audit of information exposure, source diversity, summary language, and source-summary fidelity in AI-mediated search.

papers.title: Auditing Google's AI Overviews and Featured Snippets: A Case Study on Baby Care and Pregnancy
papers.abstract: Systematic audit of 1,508 real baby-care and pregnancy queries comparing AI Overviews with Featured Snippets across consistency, relevance, medical safeguards, source categories, and sentiment alignment.

papers.title: Evolving Health Information–Seeking Behavior in the Context of Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Alexa: Interview Study Using the Think-Aloud Protocol
papers.abstract: Think-aloud study with 27 participants examining how people search for health information using Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Alexa, including trust, credibility assessment, platform choice, and source-checking behavior.

papers.title: Google AI Overviews: Challenges and Opportunities for Information and Communications Scholars
papers.abstract: A scholarly overview of Google AI Overviews and its implications for information and communication research, identifying research challenges created by AI-mediated search.

papers.title: Google AI Overviews Are Here to Stay: A Call to Teach AI Literacy
papers.abstract: Discusses the implications of Google AI Overviews for information literacy instruction and argues that AI-generated search summaries require new forms of source evaluation and AI literacy.

papers.title: Health Insurance Literacy Among Young Adults: The Role of Search Generative Experience and AI
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Association for Information Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Examines young adults' health insurance literacy and search behavior, including engagement with Google's Search Generative Experience for simplified explanations and credibility assessment.

papers.title: Search Engines and Generative Artificial Intelligence Integration: Public Health Risks and Recommendations to Safeguard Consumers Online
papers.abstract: Compares Google Search Generative Experience and Bing Chat for medication-related searches, examining whether generative search recommendations direct consumers to legitimate or illegal online pharmacies.

papers.title: Evaluating Verifiability in Generative Search Engines
papers.abstract: A human audit of generative search engines focused on citation completeness and citation correctness. It provides an early benchmark for the verifiability problems that later became central to Google AI Overviews research.
